decision.reason: Yicai reports China Transportation Ministry, Industry Ministry, Energy Administration's 2026-2030 river shipping strategy including doubling new-energy ship stock by 2028 and electric vessel/port charging corridor targets, creating a route infrastructure checklist hypothesis.
decision.article_title: 三部门：到2028年，内河新能源船舶保有量较2025年翻倍 - 第一财经

opportunities.idea_name: Inland Vessel Energy Corridor Readiness Desk
opportunities.core_job: Plan port/river-segment readiness and track new-energy vessel charger/methanol-fueling gaps for 2026-2030 targets
opportunities.target_customer: Inland river port operators, vessel conversion programs and regional maritime infrastructure planners
opportunities.product_mechanism: Route/port assets CSV → vessel energy type and turnaround → shore charging or methanol coverage map/list → budget/milestones/evidence
opportunities.why_now: Chinese ministries issued 2026–2030 inland new-energy ship implementation action plan: electric transport vessels over 1,000 by 2028 and 3,000km green routes target
opportunities.before_state: Shore facility/ship energy needs and capex deadline evidence are not consistently tracked across ports
opportunities.after_state: Exportable deterministic route-coverage and project readiness checklist; no live maps or ship telemetry

source_observations.observation: Yicai reports three ministries' new plan with 2028 electric vessel and zero-carbon river corridor targets.
